title: Exercise 7: A Simulated Deploy Step
description: A workflow step that replaces the real deploy with an echo, so you can exercise the trigger, secret injection, and guardrail without a cloud bill.

steps.description: This is the simulated-deploy fallback for Exercise 7. It stands in for the real deploy step when you have no Cloudflare account.
The step is named `Deploy (simulated)`, and its `run` prints `would deploy ${WORKER_NAME}` followed by a note that the real `wrangler deploy` goes here.
The `env` block supplies `WORKER_NAME` from `vars.WORKER_NAME`, so the step still exercises secret injection and the guardrail even though nothing is deployed.

steps.question: The exercise has you show one run that your guardrail refused and one that it allowed. Which human judgment does the guardrail replace?
steps.answer: the actor allowlist, branch restriction, or environment approval you chose
